trigger_condition: User cancels or clearRows fires after the hint expiry retained the id
potential_consequence: Abandoned flow still beacons result:'timeout'; late callback flips a dismissed row

trigger_condition: Chat switched after hint expiry; retained flow's callback arrives later
potential_consequence: Late success applied to the newly opened chat; origin chat's row stays spinning

trigger_condition: Callback accepted via retention for an id already removed from tracked ids
potential_consequence: authFlows entry resurrected for an untracked id and never cleaned until unmount

trigger_condition: Caller passes NaN, zero or negative hintMs to the newly parameterized helper
potential_consequence: Math.max yields NaN; setTimeout fires immediately, beaconing an instant false timeout

trigger_condition: Retry re-flags the row authenticating before any render drops it from tracked ids
potential_consequence: Retry gets no hint timer; spinner never rolls back, stale retention and deadline persist

trigger_condition: Same auth_config_id present on two prompt messages, newest one not authenticating
potential_consequence: Callback lands on the newest idle row; the authenticating row stays stuck spinning

trigger_condition: Rollback previously touched only rows actively authenticating, never terminal ones
potential_consequence: config_error/discovery_failed rows rewritten to authentication_required, offering sign-in that cannot succeed

trigger_condition: Run status set to aborted while phases.0 and current_phase stay running
potential_consequence: Ledger tooling counts a running phase inside an aborted run; resume logic misfires
